title: Nepal river and catchment authority registry
purpose: Govern authoritative river-line and catchment/basin polygon sources for the Hydropower PhD research database and map without inventing geometry or republishing restricted government vector data.

primary_authority.provider: Department of Survey, Government of Nepal
primary_authority.reason: Survey Department hydrographic vectors are official topographic data and are distributed under the Department's data-distribution rules; raw licensed geometry is not copied into this public repository without explicit redistribution permission.

supporting_authorities.provider: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Government of Nepal
supporting_authorities.role: Hydrological station, river-name and basin-name observations
supporting_authorities.geometry_role: station points and hydrological attribution; not a substitute for river centerline geometry

supporting_authorities.provider: Water and Energy Commission Secretariat, Government of Nepal
supporting_authorities.role: National drainage and basin planning framework

primary_authority.provider: Water and Energy Commission Secretariat, Government of Nepal
primary_authority.dataset_family: River Basin Atlas of Nepal / River Basin Plan
primary_authority.geometry_rule: Do not digitize or infer basin boundaries from a picture when a governed GIS vector can be obtained. Store the official vector or an explicitly labelled open analytical derivative only after provenance and redistribution rights are verified.

allowed_now: derived statistics that can be reproduced and legally published
withheld_until_cleared: raw Survey Department hydrographic vector geometry when redistribution permission is not established
official basin polygons whose downloadable vector provenance/licence has not yet been verified
